notes.title: Patch 2 now live!
notes.content:
Check out what's new in the latest version of Infinite Air:
[list]
[*] [b]Improved onboarding and new tutorials.[/b] Get more in-depth. Visit the Tutorials Menu to access the new lessons.
[*] [b]Videos.[/b] Visit the Videos menu to access video tutorials, highlight reels, and more!
[*] [b]Better Discovery Tools.[/b] New sorting options, favouriting, and messaging makes finding and sharing your creations easier.
[*] [b]Gameplay Tuning.[/b] Small adjustments to make everything a bit smoother and more realistic.
[*] [b]Vibration.[/b] You can now get tactile feedback. Enable in the Settings menu.
[*] [b]Bug fixes and improvements.[/b] We're always listening to the community to help make Infinite Air better.
[/list]
